title: EphemHeader
description: Header (web/public/data/ephem.json) for the Sun/Earth reference table ephem.bin. The binary is n rows x 6 little-endian float32, row-major, in the order of `fields`; row k is the instant t0_iso + k * step_hours; file length is n * 24 bytes.

t0_iso.description: Instant of row 0, UTC ISO 8601 with Z.

step_hours.description: Time between consecutive rows in hours.

fields.description: Column order of each row. sun_lat, sun_lon: sub-solar point in degrees; earth_lat, earth_lon: sub-Earth point in degrees; both in the Moon-fixed mean-Earth frame, longitude east-positive in [-180, 180). sun_dist_km, earth_dist_km: distance from the Moon's centre to the body's centre in kilometres.

dtype.description: Element type of ephem.bin (no units): IEEE 754 binary32, little-endian.
